description:
*Finding True Light: Testimony of an Ex-Yogi* | Our guest, Mike Shreve, shares his personal spiritual journey from Eastern religion to Christianity. He was a yoga and meditation teacher at four universities and ran a yoga ashram—until a dramatic encounter with God caused him to leave it all behind... He was recently interviewed by @StevenBancarz.
